data.narrative:
Rivan is a Series A-stage climate and energy company founded by Harvey Hodd that has raised $47.2M to date. The addressable sector includes nine private peers (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) and one public comparable (LNZA), though the company's specific technology focus and valuation tier do not align closely enough with same-stage or adjacent-stage peers to support a reliable peer-median benchmark.

Given data constraints, valuation relies on stage-progression analysis, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $47.2M total raised as a proxy baseline. This method yields an implied valuation of $94.4M. A sensitivity range accounting for modest variance around this single-method estimate spans $80M (low) to $109M (high).

The $94M median valuation is supported by early-stage capital deployment but carries material uncertainty. Key risks include limited peer comparability within the Climate & Energy sector, absence of revenue or operational milestones in the provided data, and reliance on stage-based multiples rather than fundamental metrics. Investors should seek additional detail on burn rate, technology differentiation, and pathway to Series B to refine this range.
